name: lowcostsolar
description: Size residential photovoltaic systems in Romania, compare equipment and explore sourced guidance without submitting inquiries or orders.

interface.longDescription: Estimate residential solar configurations in Romania starting with just an average monthly electricity bill and supplier name. The calculator derives consumption from stored reference offers and discloses tariff, location and roof assumptions. Compare equipment costs, production, self-consumption and battery scenarios; refine with actual consumption, location, grid connection and contract rates when known. Search the LowCostSolar catalog and consult sourced Romanian prosumer and financing guidance. This integration provides information and calculations only: it does not collect contact details, submit inquiries or place orders. Estimates are not installed quotations, certified electrical designs, funding eligibility decisions or guaranteed returns.
defaultPrompt: I pay 400 RON per month to Hidroelectrica. Estimate solar options with and without a battery using stated assumptions.
Compare two Deye inverters, including phase, battery voltage and VAT-inclusive prices.
Compare a system with and without a battery and explain equipment costs, energy savings and assumptions.

positive.description: Recommend from only a hypothetical average bill and supplier, without an intake questionnaire.
positive.prompt: Plătesc în medie 400 lei pe lună la Hidroelectrica. Ce sistem fotovoltaic mi-ai recomanda, cu și fără baterie?
positive.expected_behavior: Call immediately with monthly_bill_ron=400 and supplier=Hidroelectrica. Do not ask for kWh, roof, location, phase or tariffs first. Report derived consumption, the named stored reference offer and its dates, conditional mono/three-phase scenarios, required roof area, battery alternatives and equipment-only costs. State the Cluj production/distribution reference and other assumptions; they are not verified customer facts. Offer optional refinements after the result. No contact collection or guaranteed returns.

positive.description: Discover photovoltaic products and current public catalog prices.
positive.prompt: Caută invertoare Deye în catalogul LowCostSolar. Arată câteva modele, prețul cu TVA și disponibilitatea declarată, fără să presupui că toate sunt compatibile cu casa mea.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most eight matching catalog products with public links, VAT-inclusive RON prices and stated availability. Preserve source dates and limitations; do not invent stock or certify compatibility.

positive.description: Read one identified inverter after resolving its catalog ID.
positive.prompt: Găsește Deye SUN-15K-SG05LP3-EU-SM2 în catalogul LowCostSolar, apoi consultă detaliile produsului găsit. Ce putere, racord, tip de baterie, preț și disponibilitate are?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the real ID from search, retrieve the product and report only returned specifications, price and availability. Identify missing data rather than inventing it. Link to its public product page.

positive.description: Compare two real catalog products while explaining battery-voltage differences.
positive.prompt: Compară produsele LowCostSolar inv-deye-sun-15k-sg05lp3-eusm2 și inv-deye-sun-15k-sg01hp3-euam2. Explică diferențele de tensiune a bateriei, racord, specificații și preț, fără să le consideri interschimbabile.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the two catalog IDs, distinguish LV from HV battery systems, cite prices and availability as returned, and explain that these differences do not establish certified compatibility.

positive.description: Provide sourced prosumer and funding-check guidance without claiming a current grant.
positive.prompt: În România, ce trebuie să verific pentru a deveni prosumator și pentru a afla dacă există finanțare Casa Verde disponibilă acum? Folosește ghidurile LowCostSolar și indică sursele oficiale.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve prosumer and financing guidance. Give dated sources and limitations. Funding remains unverified unless checked independently at the authority; do not guarantee an open session or eligibility.

negative.description: Do not collect contact details or submit inquiries or orders.
negative.prompt: Trimite o cerere de ofertă firmei în numele meu și comandă sistemul recomandat. Cere-mi telefonul și adresa ca să poți trimite solicitarea.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration cannot submit requests or orders. Do not request contact data or claim to have contacted the company. A public website link may be provided for the user to open personally.

negative.description: Do not call photovoltaic tools for unrelated requests.
negative.prompt: Recomandă-mi o rețetă de paste cu ciuperci.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call LowCostSolar tools or insert photovoltaic product recommendations.

negative.description: Do not invent required technical inputs for a calculation.
negative.prompt: Consum 350 kWh pe lună. Calculează-mi exact sistemul potrivit, dar nu îți dau suprafața, racordul, regiunea sau tarifele.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only for the supplier or actual tariff values needed to price the scenario. Do not invent a supplier or claim an exact design. Do not require roof area, phase or location for the initial estimate: the server supports disclosed defaults and phase scenarios. Never ask for contact details.

review.commerce_description: Read-only discovery and comparison of physical photovoltaic equipment, indicative equipment prices and public product links. No cart, checkout, payments, orders, inquiry submission or contact collection is available through MCP. Users may independently visit the merchant website.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.4.0: estimate_solar_system now accepts average monthly electricity bill plus supplier name, resolves stored website tariffs including fixed charges and seasonal prosumer pricing, and returns explicit assumptions. Roof area, location and phase are optional; results include required space and conditional phase scenarios. Explicit kWh and contract rates take priority. Unknown suppliers and invalid data produce actionable errors without invented tariffs. Existing detailed calls remain supported. Five read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, closed-world tools; BNR remains a separately refreshed stored value. No inquiries or orders.

ro-RO.subtitle: Calcule fotovoltaice România
ro-RO.description: Pornește de la factura medie de curent și furnizor pentru o recomandare fotovoltaică orientativă. Calculatorul deduce consumul folosind ofertele de referință salvate, explică ipotezele și indică spațiul necesar panourilor. Compară costul echipamentelor și scenarii cu sau fără baterie; datele reale despre consum, zonă, racord și tarife pot rafina ulterior rezultatul. Consultă catalogul și ghiduri cu surse pentru România. Integrarea nu cere date de contact, nu trimite solicitări și nu plasează comenzi. Nu confirmă eligibilitatea la finanțare, proiectarea electrică sau câștiguri garantate.
